items.title: Trump says US-Iran deal to be signed on Sunday as Tehran casts doubt on timing
items.description: The US president's comments come as Iran says an exact date has not been decided.

items.title: Switzerland votes on plan to cap population at 10 million
items.description: The right-wing Swiss People's Party calls the plan a "sustainability initiative",  but opponents say it is a recipe for chaos.

items.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
items.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

items.title: New York Knicks win NBA championship for first time in over 50 years
items.description: The Knicks clinched the title against the San Antonio Spurs, 94-90, in the fifth game of the best-of-seven series.

items.title: Author Chimamanda Adichie accuses hospital of stalling review into son's death
items.description: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's 21-month old son died in a Lagos hospital, which she says is trying to stop an inquest into the circumstances of his death.

items.title: Vincent's parents 'never say he's good enough' - so he turned to a middle-aged couple online
items.description: A niche group of content creators called "virtual parents" have become hugely popular among young people.

items.title: Norway braces for verdict in rape trial of crown princess's son Høiby
items.description: Marius Borg Høiby will appear via video link, almost three months after his trial came to an end on 40 charges, including four counts of rape.

items.title: Armed men kidnap high-ranking security official in Haiti
items.description: James Boyard's abduction is the highest-ranking abduction in the violence-wracked country in recent years, according to reports.

items.title: Trump's name removed from Kennedy Center after court order
items.description: Crews erected scaffolding on Friday as onlookers gathered into the evening, though storms delayed the work until Saturday.

items.title: Kidnapped Nigerian retired general dies in captivity
items.description: Maj Gen Rabe Abubakar's death highlights continuing security challenges facing parts of the country.

items.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
items.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

items.title: Anthropic suspends new AI tools over US government security concerns
items.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, released publicly this week, sparked concerns about cybersecurity and hacking.
